changeSet.author: hephaestus
changeSet.comment: The mentor's per-account serialization row, and what each request version admitted and how its delivery is fenced. Nothing writes these before the release that registers them in the person-data inventory.
changeSet.sql:
CREATE TABLE public.mentor_owner ( account_id BIGINT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT mentor_ownerPK PRIMARY KEY, created_at TIMESTAMP(6) WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL ); ALTER TABLE public.mentor_owner ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY; CREATE POLICY mentor_owner_owner ON public.mentor_owner TO hephaestus_app USING (account_id = public.current_owner_account()) WITH CHECK (account_id = public.current_owner_account());
-- Intake has written no request yet (the route answers LEGACY), so the new columns can be required without a default. ALTER TABLE public.mentor_request ADD COLUMN admitted_revision VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, ADD COLUMN admitted_source_ref VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, ADD COLUMN delivery_generation BIGINT NOT NULL, ADD COLUMN delivery_fence VARCHAR(16) CONSTRAINT ck_mentor_request_delivery_fence CHECK (delivery_fence IN ('STOPPED', 'SOURCE_DELETED', 'SOURCE_EDITED')), ADD COLUMN end_reason VARCHAR(32) CONSTRAINT ck_mentor_request_end_reason CHECK (end_reason IN ('STOPPED', 'SOURCE_DELETED')), ADD COLUMN settled_at TIMESTAMP(6) WITH TIME ZONE;

rollback.sql: ALTER TABLE public.mentor_request DROP COLUMN settled_at, DROP COLUMN end_reason, DROP COLUMN delivery_fence, DROP COLUMN delivery_generation, DROP COLUMN admitted_source_ref, DROP COLUMN admitted_revision
